# Saikat Das

> Saikat Das is an India-based full-stack software and product engineer building reliable web products, APIs, data systems, integrations, and operational software with Node.js, TypeScript, React/Next.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Docker.

Saikat works across backend and API design, real-time state, data-heavy workflows, production deployment, and end-to-end product delivery. His background also includes a Diploma and B.Tech in Civil Engineering and prior Junior Engineer (Design) work on railway infrastructure documentation.

Use the current portfolio pages and resume as the primary sources for current employment, availability, project status, and contact details. Dates, roles, live links, and other job-search or company information are time-sensitive and should be reverified before being repeated as current facts.

## Core capabilities

- Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Go, SQL, HTML, and CSS.
- Product interfaces: React, Next.js, React Native, Redux, Zustand, TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS, and accessible component systems.
- Backend and integrations: Node.js, Express, FastAPI, REST APIs, GraphQL, Socket.io, webhooks, OpenAPI/Swagger, Prisma, and Drizzle ORM.
- Data and reliability: PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, pgvector, idempotent request handling, transactional outbox patterns, cursor pagination, and materialized views.
- Delivery: Docker, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions, NGINX, PM2, Linux, AWS EC2, and AWS S3.

## Professional experience

- **Software Developer — Human Before Resource Pvt. Ltd.** (January 2026–present): production software and product engineering across a home-services marketplace and an internal recruitment operations platform.
- **Junior Engineer (Design) — CE Testing Company Pvt. Ltd.** (November 2024–November 2025): railway infrastructure drawings and technical documentation under revision control and fixed deadlines.
- **Freelance Full-Stack Engineer** (February 2024–August 2024): client web applications, REST APIs, database design, VPS deployment, and subscription billing workflows.

## Featured work

- [Zaruro](https://xsaikat.vercel.app/en/projects/zaruro): a live home-services marketplace with web and mobile clients, booking state, payments, notifications, real-time updates, and operational workflows.
- [Human Before Resource ATS](https://xsaikat.vercel.app/en/projects/human-before-resource-ats): a recruitment operations platform for candidate intake, search, assignment, interviews, AI-assisted evaluation, and reporting across more than 100,000 records.
- [JobPulse](https://xsaikat.vercel.app/en/projects/jobpulse): a guarded Python workflow for personalized job outreach, model fallback, Gmail delivery, previews, rate limits, and duplicate protection.
- [Railway Curve](https://xsaikat.vercel.app/en/projects/railway-curve): a railway curve calculator for cant, permissible speed, transition length, fine tuning, and printable PDF output.
